episodes.title: Introduction to Latin American Literature
episodes.description: Explore how Latin American writers address questions of identity within a diverse region shaped by many influences.

episodes.title: The History of Latin American Literature
episodes.description: Trace Latin American storytelling from pre-Columbian traditions to the literary Boom of the 1960s.

episodes.title: Nature in Latin American Literature
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Latin American Literature, we’ll uncover how representations of Latin American landscapes have often reflected shifting social and political concerns.

episodes.title: Tyrants, Dictators, & Strongmen
episodes.description: Strongmen, tyrants, and dictators have marked Latin America’s history — and literature — for hundreds of years.

episodes.title: Life under a dictatorship
episodes.description: Explore how writers raised amid dictatorships and armed conflict grapple with memories of violence and the limits of remembering.

episodes.title: Horror in Latin American literature
episodes.description: Explore the origins of Latin American horror through haunted places, ghost towns, and the Andes.

episodes.title: Borders & Identity
episodes.description: Explore how exile and crossing national borders have inspired experimentation in Latin American literature.

episodes.title: The Hidden Politics of Home
episodes.description: Explore how houses and homes represent identity in Latin American literature.

episodes.title: Family, Power, and Legacy
episodes.description: In this episode of Crash Course Latin American Literature, we’ll take a look at a 19th-century romance novel and poems about motherhood.

episodes.title: Animals & Shapeshifters
episodes.description: Explore how animal figures in Latin American literature illuminate human nature.

episodes.title: How has technology influenced literature?
episodes.description: Explore how Latin American writers have responded to technological developments, from Maya calendars to weapons of mass destruction.

episodes.title: Film & Literature
episodes.description: Explore the exchange between Latin American literature and cinema and how each art form illuminates the other.

episodes.title: The importance of translation
episodes.description: In our final episode of Crash Course Latin American Literature, we’ll explore how literature is shaped by readers and translators, too.
